c74object.name: evi_adaa
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_adaa.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_adaa.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_adaa.genexpr file also requires:
evi_utilities.genexpr
About this File:
'Adaa' stands for 'Anti-derivative anti-aliasing', which is an important technique for anti-aliasing memoryless nonlinearities without resorting to oversampling, or as a precursor to oversampling (thus reducing the amount of oversampling required). The technique involves time domain convolution of a function with it's anti-derivatives. You should always use this technique instead of naive waveshapers to minimise aliasing distortion in your audio signal chains. evieve uses these Adaa functions all over the Package to apply nonlinear behaviour.
